description: Implementation of the DnsConfigService class managing DNS configuration and hosts reading, watching, and updating logic within the net namespace.

classes.name: DnsConfigService
classes.description: Manages DNS configuration and hosts reading, watching, and updating logic.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::Watcher
classes.description: Handles configuration and hosts change notifications.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::HostsReader
classes.description: Reads and parses DNS hosts from a file, supports work items for asynchronous processing.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::HostsReader::WorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work for reading and parsing DNS hosts.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::DnsConfigService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DNS config service with file path and optional delay.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::WatchConfig
methods.description: Starts watching for DNS configuration changes.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnConfigRead
methods.description: Handles completion of DNS config read.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnHostsRead
methods.description: Handles completion of DNS hosts read.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer to delay config update notifications.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles timer expiration to trigger config update.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnCompleteConfig
methods.description: Finalizes and sends the updated DNS config.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles external DNS config change notifications, with optional delay.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnHostsChanged
methods.description: Handles external DNS hosts change notifications.
